name: API Integration & Contract Testing Patterns
description: Governing API integration patterns, contract testing strategies, and consumer-facing integration standards across the organization. IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: Backend's be_api_design.event_driven_apis_webhooks covers coding HMAC-SHA256 webhook dispatching and retry middleware in a single service (implementation); Backend's be_api_design.api_gateway_routing covers configuring Kong reverse proxy routes and BFF aggregation (implementation); Backend's be_testing_quality.api_contract_testing covers writing Pact consumer-provider test code (implementation). API Design's api_integration_patterns covers defining webhook contract standards that all services must follow, architecting gateway topology decisions, SDK generation strategies from OpenAPI specs, and establishing contract testing governance policies across the entire API program (strategic/architectural decision-making).

subskills.name: Webhook Contract Design Standards
subskills.description: Defining organizational webhook contract standards — event payload envelope formats, webhook registration API patterns, signature verification requirements (HMAC-SHA256 standard), retry policy documentation, and webhook event catalog governance.

subskills.name: Event-Driven API Architecture Patterns
subskills.description: Designing event-driven API patterns at the platform level — CloudEvents specification adoption, event naming taxonomy, event versioning strategies, event ordering guarantees documentation, and event-carried state transfer vs event notification trade-off frameworks.

subskills.name: API Gateway Topology & Architecture
subskills.description: Designing API gateway architecture decisions — single vs multi-gateway topology, gateway per domain/team ownership, request routing and transformation policies, protocol translation strategies (gRPC-JSON transcoding), and gateway vendor selection criteria (Kong, Apigee, AWS API Gateway, Tyk).

subskills.name: Service Mesh API Routing & Traffic Management
subskills.description: Designing API-level traffic management through service mesh — canary routing policies, traffic splitting for A/B testing, header-based routing rules, circuit breaking at the mesh level, and retry/timeout policies defined as API platform standards.

subskills.name: SDK & Client Library Generation Strategy
subskills.description: Designing SDK generation strategies from API specifications — openapi-generator configuration, language-specific SDK customization, SDK versioning aligned with API versions, generated client testing requirements, and developer experience (DX) quality standards for generated SDKs.

subskills.name: Contract Testing Strategy & Governance
subskills.description: Establishing organization-wide API contract testing governance — Pact broker deployment policies, consumer-driven contract workflow standards, can-i-deploy gate integration in CI/CD, contract test coverage requirements, and bi-directional contract testing approaches.

subskills.name: API Mocking & Service Virtualization
subskills.description: Designing API mocking and virtualization strategies — Prism mock server from OpenAPI specs, WireMock service virtualization, mock server provisioning in developer portals, stateful mock behavior standards, and sandbox environment architecture.

subskills.name: Backward Compatibility Testing & Verification
subskills.description: Designing automated backward compatibility verification pipelines — OpenAPI diff tools (oasdiff, openapi-diff), semantic versioning enforcement based on breaking changes, shadow traffic testing against new API versions, and consumer impact analysis before deployment.

subskills.name: Consumer-Driven Contract Design Philosophy
subskills.description: Establishing consumer-driven API design philosophy — consumer feedback loops, API design reviews with consuming teams, Pact contract pact authoring by consumer teams, provider verification workflows, and resolving contract conflicts between multiple consumers.
